name: erf_7_9_3
doc: Gautschi continued fraction for the Faddeeva function (DLMF 7.9.3): `w(z) = (i/√π)·1/(z − ½/(z − 1/(z − 3/2/(z − ⋯))))`
concl: Filter.Tendsto (fun N => (Complex.I/(Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ)) * cfConvC (fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else if k = 1 then 1 else -((k:ℂ)-1)/2) (fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else z) N) Filter.atTop (nhds (faddeeva z))
